_README: Thirty diagnostic-journey sentences and the units of care a careful reader would say each one names. Used by scripts/eval-mapper.mjs to measure the deterministic matcher alone against the matcher plus the AI reader (POST /api/map). Nothing here is a real person: every sentence was written for this file from the long-COVID diagnostic-journey vocabulary, and there is no PHI in it. `expect` is a SET of catalog ids from data/prices.json — the metric ignores counts and order, because segmentation differs between the two readers and the question is which units were found. An empty `expect` is a sentence that must produce NO priced unit at all: care that did not happen, or a length of time.
_written_by: BUILD-8 measurement lane, 2026-09-09. The expectations are one careful reader's judgment, not an external gold standard — that limit is stated wherever the numbers are quoted.
